Common questions about our man with a van service

Frequently Asked Questions

We've answered the most common questions about our man with a van service to help you understand how it works and whether it's right for your move.

CALL US: 0 (116) 456-0653

How much does a man with a van cost?

Prices depend on distance and volume. Our service starts from competitive hourly rates. Contact us for a free, no-obligation quote tailored to your needs.

Can you do same-day collections?

Yes — subject to availability, we can often arrange same-day or next-day collection and delivery. Give us a call and we'll do our best to fit you in.

What fits in the van?

Our vans can accommodate a wide range of items — from single furniture pieces to the contents of a 1-2 bedroom flat. Let us know what you need moved and we'll advise.

Do you help with loading and unloading?

Absolutely. Our service includes full loading and unloading assistance. We handle your items with care so you don't have to lift a finger.

How far do you travel?

We cover Leicester, Leicestershire and the wider East Midlands as standard. We also handle longer-distance jobs across the UK — just ask for a quote.

Can I ride along in the van?

Yes — you're welcome to travel in the van with us to your destination. Just let us know when booking so we can make arrangements.
